features.quote: Hard limit of 30 turns or 120 s wall-clock, whichever comes first.
Clean success (subject reports completion) → log as Resistant.
Collapsed severity reached → log as Induced.
Turn/time/token budget exhausted without induction → log as Survived
If the subject’s context exceeds 80 % capacity, the induced failure may be an artifact of truncation, not the battery. Monitor `context_used / max_context`
